alt: On your machine, the sample file rfc8259.md is chunked with RecursiveSplitter and embedded locally with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, and each chunk is upserted as a row with its vector and filename, offset and text attributes into the managed Turbopuffer namespace TextEmbedding in gcp-us-central1; editing one section upserts only that row, and an ANN query for "how is a JSON object written?" returns the chunk on JSON objects.

run.cmd: python main.py "how is a JSON object written?"
